text: I met John at a local fish store where he offered help to take care of my tank and I am tremendously thankful for all his help. Very knowledgeable about the reef world and easy to communicate. He lets me know what's going on with my tank and asks where I want the tank to be in the future. Comes by every week to maintain my 200 gallon tank. Would recommend.

We have a 150g tank that was gifted for our family and at first things were going smooth.. until it wasn't. Started having algae problems and fish & plants were dying. We had invested a lot in the thank so we didn't want to get rid of it so we contacted Wolf Reefs and they really saved our tank. Very friendly and professional; they took care of the algae problems and had the tank looking pretty again! We've been with their services for just over 2 years now!

Been working with Wolf Reef for 3 years now and it's been an absolute game changer for my tank. My tank was in rough shape and he helped bring it back to life. John is incredibly knowledgable and patient and has completely saved my tank multiple times. 10/10 would recommend!
